purpose: Name the renderer word that counts buffered actor sprite payload records.

producer.name: Render_BuildActorSpritePayload
producer.operation: Increment the low byte once for each 14-byte payload record copied to the renderer output buffer.

initializers.name: AnimationVM_RunActorPass
initializers.operation: Clear the count before building actor payloads.

initializers.name: AnimationVM_TickActors
initializers.operation: Clear the count before the animation tick path.

consumer.name: Render_SubmitActorSprites
consumer.operation: Use the count minus one to transfer the buffered 14-byte records to the VDP.

conclusion: FFEFEE is the 16-bit actor sprite payload record count; FFEFEF is its low-byte access, not an independent state.
